title: seseli fasciculatum
intro: Seseli fasciculatum, commonly known as Carrot-rooted Seseli, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in supporting digestive health and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Seseli fasciculatum include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and carminative properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of indigestion, nausea, and gas. The bioactive constituents of Seseli fasciculatum include sesquiterpene lactones and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
